import os
import requests

def detect_image_labels(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    image_url = payload.get("image_url") or payload.get("url")
    image_path = payload.get("image_path") or payload.get("path")
    api_key = config.get("api_key") or os.getenv("AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID")
    api_secret = config.get("api_secret") or os.getenv("AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY")
    region = config.get("region") or os.getenv("AWS_REGION", "us-east-1")

    if not api_key or not api_secret:
        raise ValueError("AWS credentials are required via config or environment variables.")

    if image_path:
        with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
            image_bytes = f.read()
    elif image_url:
        image_bytes = requests.get(image_url, timeout=30).content
    else:
        raise ValueError("payload must include image_url or image_path")

    endpoint = f"https://rekognition.{region}.amazonaws.com/"
    headers = {
        "Content-Type": "application/x-amz-json-1.1",
        "X-Amz-Target": "RekognitionService.DetectLabels",
    }

    try:
        import boto3
        client = boto3.client(
            "rekognition",
            region_name=region,
            aws_access_key_id=api_key,
            aws_secret_access_key=api_secret,
        )
        if image_path:
            response = client.detect_labels(
                Image={"Bytes": image_bytes},
                MaxLabels=config.get("max_labels", 10),
                MinConfidence=config.get("min_confidence", 70),
            )
        else:
            response = client.detect_labels(
                Image={"Bytes": image_bytes},
                MaxLabels=config.get("max_labels", 10),
                MinConfidence=config.get("min_confidence", 70),
            )
        result = [
            {
                "name": label.get("Name"),
                "confidence": label.get("Confidence"),
                "parents": [p.get("Name") for p in label.get("Parents", [])],
            }
            for label in response.get("Labels", [])
        ]
    except Exception:
        import json
        import base64
        import hmac
        import hashlib
        import datetime
        from urllib.parse import urlparse

        service = "rekognition"
        host = f"rekognition.{region}.amazonaws.com"

        def sign(key, msg):
            return hmac.new(key, msg.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).digest()

        def get_signature_key(key, date_stamp, region_name, service_name):
            k_date = sign(("AWS4" + key).encode("utf-8"), date_stamp)
            k_region = hmac.new(k_date, region_name.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).digest()
            k_service = hmac.new(k_region, service_name.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).digest()
            k_signing = hmac.new(k_service, b"aws4_request", hashlib.sha256).digest()
            return k_signing

        t = datetime.datetime.utcnow()
        amz_date = t.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
        date_stamp = t.strftime("%Y%m%d")

        payload_json = {
            "Image": {"Bytes": base64.b64encode(image_bytes).decode("utf-8")},
            "MaxLabels": config.get("max_labels", 10),
            "MinConfidence": config.get("min_confidence", 70),
        }
        request_payload = json.dumps(payload_json)

        canonical_uri = "/"
        canonical_querystring = ""
        canonical_headers = (
            f"content-type:application/x-amz-json-1.1\n"
            f"host:{host}\n"
            f"x-amz-date:{amz_date}\n"
            f"x-amz-target:RekognitionService.DetectLabels\n"
        )
        signed_headers = "content-type;host;x-amz-date;x-amz-target"
        payload_hash = hashlib.sha256(request_payload.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        canonical_request = (
            "POST\n"
            f"{canonical_uri}\n"
            f"{canonical_querystring}\n"
            f"{canonical_headers}\n"
            f"{signed_headers}\n"
            f"{payload_hash}"
        )
        algorithm = "AWS4-HMAC-SHA256"
        credential_scope = f"{date_stamp}/{region}/{service}/aws4_request"
        string_to_sign = (
            f"{algorithm}\n"
            f"{amz_date}\n"
            f"{credential_scope}\n"
            f"{hashlib.sha256(canonical_request.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()}"
        )
        signing_key = get_signature_key(api_secret, date_stamp, region, service)
        signature = hmac.new(signing_key, string_to_sign.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
        authorization_header = (
            f"{algorithm} Credential={api_key}/{credential_scope}, "
            f"SignedHeaders={signed_headers}, Signature={signature}"
        )

        response = requests.post(
            endpoint,
            data=request_payload,
            headers={**headers, "X-Amz-Date": amz_date, "Authorization": authorization_header},
            timeout=30,
        )
        response.raise_for_status()
        data = response.json()
        result = [
            {
                "name": label.get("Name"),
                "confidence": label.get("Confidence"),
                "parents": [p.get("Name") for p in label.get("Parents", [])],
            }
            for label in data.get("Labels", [])
        ]
    return result
